spans.s:
m. (-न्दः)
A building of several stories, and surrounded by a portico, or having a portico to the east and west only; a palace, a temple.
E.
वि before छन्द wish, will; also with कन् added, विछन्दक, and derived from छृदि to be splendid, with वुन् aff. विछर्द्दक.

m. (-कः)
A large and handsome building, the temple of a god, or the palace of a prince: see the last.

Being sick.
E.
वि before छृदि to vomit, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Disregarded, neglected.
2 Diminished, impaired.
3 Vomited.
E.
वि before छृद to vomit, क्त aff.

n. (-यं)
The shadow of a flock of birds.
E.
वि a bird, छाय a shadow, which in this sort of compound becomes neuter.
